name: New York City Leading Causes of Death
description:
This dataset contains records of the leading causes of death in New York City from 2007 through 2021. Each row pairs a year and a specific leading cause of death with a breakdown by sex and race/ethnicity, along with the number of deaths and two rate measures: the crude death rate and the age-adjusted death rate. Causes include broad categories such as diseases of the heart, influenza and pneumonia, chronic liver diseases and cirrhosis, mental and behavioral disorders, and an "all other causes" grouping. Sex values appear in both abbreviated (F, M) and spelled-out (Female, Male) forms, and race/ethnicity covers groups such as Hispanic, Black Non-Hispanic, Asian and Pacific Islander, Other Race/Ethnicity, and Not Stated/Unknown. Death counts and rates are stored as text rather than numbers, and the two rate columns are missing for roughly 16% of rows.
